the beam based offset feedback control can be used to stabilize the beam position to the required precision and that the maximum admitted noise and disturbances are given in terms of equivalent disturbance on the magnet position.
it is possible, in the presence of disturbances and noises, to achieve the required beam stability for the CLIC final focus.
the BBOF algorithm has been successfully implemented in a simulation framework.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design and the integration of BBOF in the CLIC baseline, the simulation of the control loop in presence of noise or disturbance, the analysis and quantification of the maximum noise level and the study of the impact of the limited sampling frequency on the performance.
the design of a BBOF controller for the stabilization of the beam position in the presence of ground motion.
the interaction point stability and its impact on the beam based feedback control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the BBOF is a valid solution to achieve the required performance for the CLIC baseline.
the beam based feedback can be used to stabilize the beam in the presence of ground motion.
the BBOF is an efficient tool for the stabilization of the beam position in the CLIC final focus, but that the noise and disturbance levels in the system have to be further reduced.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the beam based feedback is a good candidate to be integrated in the CLIC baseline and it is possible to meet the requirements.
the beam based feedback can be used as a stabilizing element for the final focus, but the noise level in the system has to be lowered to the required level by other means.
it is feasible to use the BBF to control the beam offset and that it is necessary to improve the ground motion isolation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the control loop is robust and the performances are stable in a large range of ground motion models, noises or disturbances.
the BBOF is a promising control algorithm that can be added to the baseline to improve the stability of the beam position.
the BBOF can be used in the CLIC final focus and the control loop can be integrated in the CLIC baseline with no additional hardware.
